full_judgment: 2. The petitioner herein as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 06 of 2002 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Sadar, Chandpur for recovery of khas possession under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act against the respondents. His case, in short, is that the plaintiff was a tenant under the father of the defendants. The father of the defendants filed S.C.C. Suit No. 01 of 1988 for ejectment of tenant and got a decree. Against the said decree, the plaintiff-petitioner filed Civil Revision No. 77 of 1989 subsequently renumbered as Civil Revision No. 4293 of 1991 and the father of the defendants also filed Civil Suit No. 220 of 1981 for enhancement of rent and it was decreed. Against the said decree, the plaintiff obtained a Rule in Civil Revision No. 4301 of 1991 in which the decree of eviction was set aside and the order passed in Rent Control Case No. 54 of 1988 was restored. Accordingly, the plaintiff had been depositing rent by challan regularly. In order to get electricity connection, the plaintiff filed Writ Petition No. 336 of 2000 and the High Court Division directed the plaintiff to seek address before the Court of Rent Controller. Therefore, the plaintiff filed Case No. 28 of 2000. The plaintiff had been carrying on business of books since the date of tenancy agreement dated 16.03.1983. The plaintiff was forcibly evicted from possession of the suit shop on 22.07.2000. On the date of occurrence, the defendants looted valuables worth about Tk. 1200,000/. Therefore, the plaintiff has filed the suit for recovery of possession.
